INTERNSHIP REPORT 
ON 
"FULL STACK JAVA DEVELOPMENT WITH AI: 
WEATHER REPORT GENERATOR" 
Submitted in partial fulfillment of the requirements for the Internship 
Course of Undergraduate Programme of Visvesvaraya Technological 
University [cite: 5]. 
Presented By: 
Miss. Arpita Balasaheb Jadhav (2VS22CS013) [cite: 6] 
Internal Guide: 
 
Prof. Shrikant Athanikar [cite: 6] 
Department of Computer Science & 
Engineering [cite: 6] 
External Guide: 
 
Prof. Sharana Basappa [cite: 6] 
 
 
 
CERTIFICATE 
Certified that this Internship report is an original report of work done under the 
guidance of internal and external supervisors, submitted as a part of the Internship

Course of Undergraduate Programme of Visvesvaraya Technological University, Jnana 
Sangama, Machhe, Belagavi-590018 [cite: 5]. 
 
 
 
ACKNOWLEDGEMENT 
Gratitude is expressed to the institution and management for providing infrastructure, 
laboratory facilities, and inspiring staff, which were of immense help in the completion 
of this report successfully [cite: 7]. Sincere thanks are conveyed to the Head of the 
Department, Computer Science and Engineering, for unwavering support, insightful 
guidance, and for making available the essential resources that greatly contributed to 
the successful execution of this project at every stage [cite: 7]. 
Special thanks are extended to Prof. Shrikant Athanikar and Prof. Sharana Basappa for 
their valuable suggestions and continuous mentorship [cite: 6]. Appreciation is also 
directed towards KodNest for the opportunity to work on real-time projects and gain 
practical industry experience [cite: 6]. 
 
 
 
INDEX OF CONTENTS 
●​ 1. About the Organization 
●​ 2. Objectives of Internship 
●​ 3. Introduction to Full Stack Java Development 
●​ 4. System Architecture and Tools Used 
●​ 5. Project Details: Weather Report Generator 
●​ 6. Learning Experiences 
●​ 7. Results and Discussion 
●​ 8. Learning Outcomes 
●​ 9. Conclusion

1. ABOUT THE ORGANIZATION 
KodNest is a software training and ed-tech company based in Bangalore [cite: 6]. 
Founded in the year 2017, the organization has consistently focused on the critical area 
of skill development specifically tailored for engineering graduates [cite: 6]. The 
technology landscape requires constant upskilling, and the company addresses this 
need by providing intensive training programs [cite: 6]. 
The core offerings of the organization involve providing specialized training in full stack 
development and software testing [cite: 6]. A major differentiator for KodNest is its 
pedagogical approach, which heavily emphasizes practical learning through the 
execution of real-time projects [cite: 6]. This ensures that theoretical knowledge is 
immediately applied to concrete, industry-standard problems. Furthermore, the 
organization is committed to the long-term success of its candidates by offering 
dedicated mentorship and robust placement support to help them launch successful IT 
careers [cite: 6]. 
 
 
2. OBJECTIVES OF INTERNSHIP 
The primary aim of undergoing this internship was to bridge the gap between 
academic theories and practical industry requirements [cite: 5]. The specific objectives 
outlined for this phase included: 
●​ To comprehensively learn Java Full Stack Development [cite: 6]. 
●​ To understand the seamless integration of frontend interfaces, backend logic, and 
database management systems [cite: 6]. 
●​ To gain tangible, hands-on experience by contributing to real-world projects [cite: 
6]. 
●​ To significantly improve coding proficiency and develop advanced debugging

skills [cite: 6]. 
●​ To learn the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and adopt standard 
industry practices [cite: 6]. 
 
 
3. INTRODUCTION TO FULL STACK JAVA 
DEVELOPMENT 
Full Stack Java Development refers to the holistic development of both the client-side 
(frontend) and server-side (backend) components of web applications using Java as 
the primary backend language. This comprehensive approach requires a deep 
understanding of various distinct layers of software architecture. 
3.1 Frontend Development 
The frontend is responsible for everything the user interacts with directly. It involves 
rendering data, handling user inputs, and managing the visual presentation of the 
application. The foundational technologies include HTML for semantic structure, CSS 
for styling and responsive layouts, and JavaScript for dynamic interactivity and DOM 
manipulation. Responsive user interfaces were actively designed and built utilizing 
HTML, CSS, and JavaScript during the internship [cite: 6]. 
3.2 Backend Development 
The backend acts as the engine of the application. It handles business logic, processes 
user requests, authenticates users, and manages data flow between the server and the 
frontend. In this training, Java was utilized to implement the necessary backend logic to 
efficiently handle user requests and dictate the application flow [cite: 6]. Java's robust 
ecosystem and multithreading capabilities make it highly suitable for enterprise-grade 
backend services. 
3.3 Database Integration 
A critical component of full-stack development is persistent data storage. Relational

databases organize data into tables, rows, and columns, ensuring data integrity 
through predefined schemas. For the projects developed, applications were 
seamlessly connected with a MySQL database, which was responsible for the secure 
storing and retrieving of critical data [cite: 6]. 
 
 
4. SYSTEM ARCHITECTURE AND TOOLS USED 
4.1 Integrated Development Environment (IDE) 
VS Code (Visual Studio Code) was utilized extensively throughout the development 
lifecycle [cite: 6]. VS Code offers powerful syntax highlighting, intelligent code 
completion, and integrated debugging tools that drastically accelerate the coding 
process across HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Java. 
4.2 Version Control 
Experience was gained in using GitHub for source code management [cite: 6]. Git 
enables tracking changes, branching for feature development, and collaborating 
effectively within a project, which aligns with modern agile workflows. 
4.3 Database Administration 
MySQL Workbench served as the primary visual tool for database architects and 
developers [cite: 6]. It provided a comprehensive interface for data modeling, SQL 
development, and comprehensive administration tools for server configuration and 
user management.

5. PROJECT DETAILS: WEATHER REPORT 
GENERATOR 
5.1 Project Introduction 
The primary project executed during Phase-I was the "Weather Report Generator" 
[cite: 6]. This application is designed to provide users with accurate, location-based 
meteorological data instantly. The system prompts the user to enter a city (e.g., 
London) to see real-time weather details [cite: 6]. 
5.2 External API Integration 
To fetch live meteorological metrics, the application relies on external data sourcing. 
Specifically, the real-time weather data is powered by OpenWeatherMap [cite: 6]. The 
backend system securely makes HTTP requests to the OpenWeatherMap REST API, 
processes the returned JSON payload, and formats it for frontend consumption.

5.3 Key Features & Data Points 
Upon successful query execution for a selected city, the application dynamically 
updates the user interface to display a comprehensive generated weather report [cite: 
6]. The dashboard presents the following critical data points to the end-user: 
●​ Current Temperature: Displayed prominently (e.g., 33°C) [cite: 6]. 
●​ Weather Condition: Graphical icons and textual descriptions (e.g., Clear Sky) 
[cite: 6]. 
●​ Humidity: Moisture level in the air (e.g., 49%) [cite: 6]. 
●​ Wind Speed: Current wind velocity (e.g., 2.57 m/s) [cite: 6]. 
●​ Feels Like Temperature: The human-perceived equivalent temperature (e.g., 
36°C) [cite: 6]. 
●​ Atmospheric Pressure: (e.g., 1010 hPa) [cite: 6]. 
 
 
6. LEARNING EXPERIENCES 
The internship actively involved working on developing web applications using Java Full 
Stack technologies [cite: 6]. Through the course of building the Weather Report 
Generator and studying other projects (such as a Travel Website image gallery), 
profound practical experience was accumulated. 
However, the development process was not without its hurdles. Several technical 
challenges were faced, which served as critical learning moments: 
●​ Database connection errors: Resolving configuration issues, driver mismatches, 
and authentication problems when linking Java applications to MySQL [cite: 6]. 
●​ Debugging code issues: Learning to effectively trace stack errors, utilize IDE 
debuggers, and isolate logical flaws within complex codebases [cite: 6]. 
●​ Understanding backend logic: Grasping how data moves from the database, 
through the data access layer, into business logic controllers, and finally to the 
client view [cite: 6].

These obstacles ultimately led to a significant improvement in problem-solving skills, as 
they were systematically resolved through rigorous practice and expert guidance from 
mentors [cite: 6]. 
 
 
7. RESULTS AND DISCUSSION 
The culmination of the development effort resulted in a fully functional, responsive 
Weather Report Generator application. The interface successfully prompts users, 
accepts input queries, and reliably fetches data from the OpenWeatherMap service 
[cite: 6]. 
Testing was conducted using various geographic inputs (e.g., Belagavi, Karnataka, IN) 
to ensure the API parsing handled dynamic JSON responses correctly [cite: 6]. The 
results successfully rendered on the dashboard included a temperature of 33°C, 49% 
humidity, wind speeds of 2.57 m/s, a "Feels Like" index of 36°C, and an atmospheric 
pressure of 1010 hPa [cite: 6]. The seamless integration of frontend design and 
backend API communication proved the efficacy of the chosen architecture. 
 
 
8. LEARNING OUTCOMES 
The objectives set forth at the beginning of the internship were successfully met. The 
primary learning outcomes derived from this experience include: 
●​ Acquiring deep knowledge of Frontend technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) 
[cite: 6]. 
●​ Mastering Backend development principles using Java [cite: 6]. 
●​ Attaining proficiency in Database management using MySQL [cite: 6]. 
●​ Improving problem-solving and debugging skills through intensive, hands-on 
practice [cite: 6]. 
●​ Gaining vital experience in using industry-standard tools like VS Code, GitHub,

and MySQL Workbench [cite: 6]. 
●​ Learning comprehensively about the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) 
and standard project workflows [cite: 6]. 
●​ Enhancing soft skills, specifically teamwork, communication, and time 
management skills [cite: 6]. 
 
 
9. CONCLUSION 
The internship at KodNest has proven to be a highly valuable learning experience so far 
[cite: 6]. Through this structured internship program, there is a continuous 
improvement taking place in technical skills across frontend, backend, and database 
technologies [cite: 6]. 
Furthermore, problem-solving and debugging abilities are constantly being enhanced 
through direct, hands-on practice with real-world applications like the Weather Report 
Generator [cite: 6]. Beyond technical acumen, the experience has fundamentally 
helped in developing teamwork, communication, and essential professional skills 
required in the corporate environment [cite: 6]. 
Looking ahead, there is great anticipation to learn more and gain even deeper industry 
knowledge as the internship progresses further into its subsequent phases [cite: 6].
